dateNote: Report states a Special Called Board Meeting was held on Monday, June 24, 2024, at 8:00 a.m.
headline: Tishomingo County School District hires new principal for Tishomingo County High School
summary: The board held a special called meeting to vote on hiring a head principal for Tishomingo County High School and approved the hire.

personnel.note: Head principal, Tishomingo County High School.

otherActions: The report states the district still had open positions at Belmont, Burnsville, the Career and Technical Center, Iuka and Tishomingo County, and needed substitute teachers.
